subject: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi

Selective detail, muted greens and earth colours, breathing space and an unforced composition, not symmetrical. No portraits, text, titles, lettering, film frames, logos, watermarks, collage, book props, screens, exaggerated drama or theatrical gestures. The illustration should evoke a reader entering a rural human story; it is not a movie still, photograph, or historical reconstruction.
